items: 🔥【300W High-Power Charging Station】Charge 24 Devices at Once with 12 USB-C & 12 USB-A Ports - Yoodarmx fast usb charging station delivers a total output of 300W, with USB-C ports supporting up to 5V/3A (15W) and USB-A ports up to 5V/2.4A (12W). Perfect for homes, offices, or businesses—eliminate cable clutter and power all your devices in one place

⚡【High-Speed Charging with Smart Power Delivery】3X Faster Charging with Intelligent Chip Technology - Our charging station for multiple devices features an upgraded smart chip that detects each device's power needs and delivers optimized current (USB-C port can charge up to 5V/3A amps & USB-A port can Charge up to 5V/2.4A). Charge your phone to 50% in under 30 minutes—3 times faster than standard charging stations.

🛡️【Multiple Safety Protection for Peace of Mind】6-Layer Safety Shield & On/Off Power Switch - Our phone charging station is rigorously tested with advanced safety features: over-temperature control, overvoltage/overcurrent protection, short-circuit prevention, and overload protection. The built-in power switch provides instant visual feedback, ensuring safe and secure charging for all your devices

💻【Wildly Compatibility for All Devices】Works with Every USB Device - Compatible with iPhone, Android, Tablets & More - Yoodarmx multiport charging dock station supports all USB-powered devices, including Compatible with iPhones, Samsung Galaxy, tablet, AirPods, Kindles, gaming controllers, and more. Perfect for schools, offices, hotels, restaurants, or home use—keep all your devices organized and fully charged

🔧【Sturdy One-Piece Iron Design】Built to Last with Heavy-Duty Iron Construction - Unlike flimsy plastic charging stations, our multi-port charger features durable iron slots for long-lasting strength. The wide, case-friendly slots fit phones and tablets of all sizes—even with thick cases. Keep your desk, countertop, or nightstand clutter-free and stylish

🎁【Complete Value Pack & Reliable Support】Everything You Need in One Box - Includes 1x Yoodarmx 24-Port USB C Fast Charging Station, 1x Power Cable, and 1x English Manual. Perfect gift for Christmas, birthdays, housewarming, or Father's/Mother's Day. Backed by a 2-year free replacement and 24/7 customer support—your satisfaction is guaranteed
